method: Codex in-app browser, read-only navigation; screenshots captured before any age-confirmation action
access_notes: Direct Playwright/Chrome requests from the local network returned HTTP 403 from the site's WAF.
The in-app browser loaded the public pages. The 18+ modal appeared after a short delay on catalog and wine-detail pages; it was not confirmed or bypassed.
The homepage screenshot was captured before the delayed age modal appeared and shows the public hero composition.

screenshots.observation: Full-bleed vineyard environment, large editorial headline, and a translucent foreground content panel; imagery is treated as spatial composition rather than an icon.
Age gate over the catalog. The underlying page shows a left filter column, product grid and a top-level catalog/search area. The modal was not accepted.
Mobile wine-detail page behind the 18+ sheet: compact brand/search/menu header, centered wine name and producer, rating pill, and a large visual product area. The modal was not accepted.

indexed_page_evidence.verified_text: The public catalog exposes two primary photo-search actions: 'Сканировать' and 'Загрузить фото', followed by filters and wine cards.
The wine card leads with the wine name, producer and rating, then region, grape varieties, category/color, serving temperature, strength, food pairings, description and similar wines.
